sources.title: Project After contributors: hand-set species values

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy added with the lilies work (2026-10-18): every character from the floras in the lilies notes (plantgen-claude project-files/lilies/SOURCES.md), drawn by the rules its taxa hold; drawing values only where no character says them.

taxon.note: WCVP v16 accepted name Lilium canadense, plant_name_id 280672.

growth_form.note: A bulbous herb with one leafy flowering stem a year, drawn by the forb form.

growth.note: Grown five years from seed, as a lily bulb takes three to five to flower; drawn at its third and fifth years.

variants.note: One seed in the open, as the built-in species.

allometry.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: stems usually 0.6-1.5 m; FNA gives only 'stems to 1.8 m'. Its reference height is the middle of that range, 1.05 m, at its last keyframe.

traits.height_typical_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: stems usually 0.6-1.5 m; FNA gives only 'stems to 1.8 m'.

traits.height_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium canadense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): stems to 1.8 m

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium canadense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves in 6-10 whorls or partial whorls

traits.leaf_whorls.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium canadense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): in 6-10 whorls. The typical value is our pick of a usual plant inside that range.

traits.leaves_per_whorl.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium canadense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): 3-12 leaves per whorl. The typical value is our pick of a usual plant inside that range.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium canadense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves 4-17.3 x 1-3.6 cm

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium canadense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves 1-3.6 cm wide, 2.5-10 times longer than wide

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium canadense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): blade narrowly elliptic, occasionally elliptic or slightly lanceolate

traits.leaf_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium canadense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): more or less horizontal, occasionally slightly ascending, drooping at tips

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium canadense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): inflorescences racemose, 1-17-flowered. The typical value is our pick of a usual plant inside that range.

traits.flower_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium canadense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): flowers pendent, not fragrant

traits.corolla_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium canadense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): perianth more or less campanulate

traits.perianth_reflexion.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium canadense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): sepals and petals somewhat recurved 1/2-3/4 along length from base

traits.perianth_reflexion_from.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium canadense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): recurved 1/2-3/4 along length from base

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium canadense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): adaxial surface dirty yellow proximally and giving way to red dusting on tips, or orange, or both surfaces solid yellow; drawn as the first, its red-dusted tips The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.perianth_base_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium canadense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): adaxial surface dirty yellow proximally The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.perianth_spots.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium canadense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): spotted maroon

traits.perianth_spot_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium canadense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): spotted maroon The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.tepal_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium canadense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): sepals 5.4-8.5 cm, petals 5.3-8 cm

traits.stamen_exsertion.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium canadense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): stamens barely exserted

traits.anther_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium canadense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): anthers dull magenta or darker The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.pedicel_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium canadense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): pedicel 5-23.5 cm. The typical value is our pick of a usual plant inside that range.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium canadense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): capsules 3-5.2 x 1.5-2.3 cm

traits.fruit_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium canadense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): capsules 1.5-2.3 cm wide

traits.flowering_months.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium canadense (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): flowering summer (Jun-early Aug)
